import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int n, m;
    static final int maxn = 505;
    static long[] f = new long[maxn];
    static long[] h = new long[maxn];
    static long[][] g = new long[maxn][maxn];
    static long[][] t = new long[maxn][maxn];
    static long[][] C = new long[maxn][maxn];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        f[0] = 1;
        h[0] = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                f[i] = (f[i] + (f[i - 1 - j] * f[j] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * C[i - 1][j] % mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                long term1 = (f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % mod) * C[i - 1][j] % mod;
                long sumPart = ((long)(j + 1) * j / 2 + (long)(i - 1 - j) * (i - j) / 2) % mod;
                h[i] = (h[i] + term1 * sumPart % mod) % mod;
                long term2 = C[i - 1][j] * (i + 1) % mod * f[i - 1 - j] % mod;
                h[i] = (h[i] + term2 * h[j] % mod) % mod;
                long term3 = C[i - 1][j] * (i + 1) % mod * f[j] % mod;
                h[i] = (h[i] + term3 * h[i - 1 - j] % mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        g[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                g[i][j] = g[i - 1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    g[i][j] = (g[i][j] + C[j][l] * g[i - 1 - l][j - l] % mod * g[l][l] % mod) % mod;
                }
            }
            g[i][i] = f[i];
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                t[i][j] = t[i - 1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    t[i][j] = (t[i][j] + C[j][l] * t[i - 1 - l][j - l] % mod * f[l] % mod) % mod;
                    t[i][j] = (t[i][j] + C[j][l] * h[l] % mod * g[i - 1 - l][j - l] % mod) % mod;
                }
            }
            t[i][i] = h[i];
        }

        System.out.println(t[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
